title: Russian Smoked Tagine Bread
description: A hearty Russian-inspired bread with smoky flavor, perfect for dipping into soups or olive oil.
instructions: Slice the white bread into 1-inch thick slices.
Mix the Russian smoked paprika, oven-roasted garlic, and smoked salt in a small bowl.
Brush the mixture evenly onto each bread slice.
Dip each bread slice into the water, coating both sides.
Place the bread slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the bread is crispy and golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
